title: hashQuery fingerprint mismatches cause duplicate/ghost alert rule rows
answers: Why does the same alert rule show up twice in the rule list, one stuck pending and one 'deleting'?
Why can't the rule list tell apart two rules with the same name and labels?
Rule list shows duplicate/ghost entries for rules that share a name
hashQuery doesn't match ruler and Prometheus versions of the same expression
body:
Symptom: when several rules in a group share name and labels, the rule list falls back to comparing query text; if ruler and Prometheus spell the same expression differently, one rule renders as both a pending ruler-only row and a ghost deleting prom-only row.
Root cause: hashQuery (public/app/features/alerting/unified/utils/rule-id.ts:hashQuery) is a text-based fingerprint; Mimir/Prometheus re-serialize expressions (durations, comments, whitespace, quote style, trailing commas, empty selectors) differently than the ruler YAML, so textually-equivalent queries can hash differently.
Fix pattern: add a targeted normalization pass to hashQuery for each known re-spelling difference (see normalizePromQLDurations) rather than trying to fully parse PromQL; run new passes before whitespace is stripped since some tokens (e.g. 'offset 60m') need their word boundary intact.
Constraints: any new normalization must not rewrite text inside PromQL string literals (label matchers, label_replace templates) - a duration-shaped label value like window="60m" is a different series from window="1h" and must stay distinguishable; use the PROMQL_STRING_OR_DURATION pattern (strings matched first) as the model.
applies: public/app/features/alerting/unified/utils/rule-id.ts hashQuery and any future normalization added to it

Apply targeted normalization passes for each known re-spelling difference (e.g., normalizePromQLDurations pattern) before whitespace stripping, running word-boundary-sensitive tokens intact. Critical constraint: never rewrite text inside PromQL string literals or label matchers (e.g., window="60m" is semantically different from window="1h") — use PROMQL_STRING_OR_DURATION pattern matching strings first. Applies when implementing alert rule deduplication or adding new PromQL normalization.
